# Pixel Tip Calculator

A retro pixel-art style tip calculator built with plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Works entirely offline in the browser.

## Features

- Enter bill amount and number of people
- Choose tip percentage (10%, 15%, 20%) with pixel-style buttons
- Displays tip per person and total per person
- Keyboard accessible with visible focus states
- Responsive layout down to 360px wide

## Usage

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. No server or build step required.

## Files

- `index.html` – markup
- `styles.css` – pixel theme and layout
- `script.js` – calculation logic and interaction
